5 days | Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru, Naivasha and Hell’s Gate

Package overview

Five days for people who want the Mara without giving the whole trip to driving. Nakuru and Naivasha break the journey.

A shorter mix of lakes, a walk and the Mara. Highlights: Lake Nakuru, Boat and Hell’s Gate, Two nights in the Mara area.

Route Nairobi → Lake Nakuru → Naivasha → Masai Mara → Nairobi

Package price from

USD 2,150

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi to Lake Nakuru

About three hours, then an afternoon drive for rhinos and the lakeshore.

Accommodation: Lake Nakuru

02Day 2 | Nakuru to Naivasha

Morning drive, then a boat among the papyrus and, if you want it, a walk on Crescent Island.

Accommodation: Lake Naivasha

03Day 3 | Naivasha to the Mara

Hell’s Gate in the morning, on foot or by bike. Afternoon drive to the Mara.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

04Day 4 | Masai Mara

A full day of game drives.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

05Day 5 | Masai Mara to Nairobi

Sunrise drive and the return to Nairobi.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
